item.title: LOT-111: first-unread landing, legacy separator, reading position recording
item.body:
LOT-111
Closes #202
Refs #151 (FEAT-007: the "Nouveau" banner is LOT-178 #418, so #151 stays open)
Claim: cloud/lot-111

Credit: Bybifok ([`moust4ki`](https://github.com/moust4ki)), who found it (FEAT-007).

## Problem
Opening a flagged topic did not keep its landing message in place while images loaded, drew no separator after the flag message (legacy did), and never recorded the reading position (LOT-090 store had no caller). Per UXD-11 the "Nouveau" banner is out of scope (LOT-178).

## What changed
- `reader.js`: `landOnPost` pins the message at the top on image `load`/`error`/resize until the user touches the page or every image settled; reports the topmost message after scrolling pauses.
- `TopicReaderModel.recordPosition` + `ReaderPositionRecording` (live: LOT-090 `advance`, per account, nothing when logged out).
- Legacy separator after the flag message (`ObjCTopicMessageContentBuilder.m:25-33` @ 2440d79), landing on the next message when the flag message is deleted (`closePostID`).
- Specs: `docs/lots/LOT-111-first-unread.md`, `docs/features/FEAT-007.md`; FEATURES row.
- `ReaderLinkAction` moved to its own file only to keep `TopicReaderModel.swift` under the 400-line lint limit.
- Anchor through redirects (#106) unchanged (LOT-083/095 `numreponse` rule).

## Tests
`ReaderPositionTests`, separator tests in `TopicHTMLBuilderTests`/`TopicReaderModelTests`, `ReaderLandingWebTests` (real web view: landing, position report). Not run locally (app cannot build on Linux); SwiftLint `--strict` clean. The pin against late images is not simulated in tests: see below.

## Left open
- `ReadingPositionStore.removeAccount` not wired to account removal (to track on #202).
- Restoring a stored position when opening a topic without flag: no spec row.

Adversarial review (Opus): 3 rounds, REQUEST CHANGES, REQUEST CHANGES, APPROVE.

## Mac check needed
For `mac/m2-lead`:
- [ ] Open a flagged topic whose message above/at the anchor has slow images: the flag message stays at the top, no jump when images load.
- [ ] Touch/drag during loading releases the pin; later images do not pull the view back.
- [ ] Status-bar tap and VoiceOver scroll while pinned: pin not released by them (known gap), check it is tolerable.
- [ ] Flag message gets a dashed separator after it, not when it is the last message; visible in light, dark, Dynamic Type XL; iPhone and iPad.
- [ ] A failed image above the anchor (becomes a link) does not shift the landing.
- [ ] Reading position recorded: relaunch and check `Positions/positions.json` holds the topmost message per account (no pseudo in logs).

---
_Generated by [Claude Code](https://claude.ai/code/session_014QH2CEwcxyuDfwzXcFTyWw)_

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Opening a flagged topic now takes you to the first unread message and keeps it in view while images load. Scrolling or other input releases the positioning.
  * A dashed separator marks the flagged message when it appears before another message.
  * Reading positions are recorded as you scroll for the current account.
* **Bug Fixes**
  * If the flagged message is no longer available, the reader moves to the next available message instead of leaving you without a destination.

Walkthrough

The reader resolves flagged-message anchors, holds the landing position while images and layout settle, and renders a legacy-style separator. It reports visible messages and records valid reading positions for the active account. **Changes: First-unread reader behavior** |Layer / File(s)|Summary| |:---|:---| |**Anchor resolution and separator rendering**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderLinkAction.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderDocument.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicHTMLBuilder.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Resources/reader.css`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/TopicHTMLBuilderTests.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/TopicReaderModelTests.swift`, `docs/FEATURES.md`, `docs/features/FEAT-007.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-111-first-unread.md`|Target navigation falls forward to the first non-continuation message at or after the requested response number. The document builder inserts a dashed separator after the target message only when a later message exists. Tests cover existing and missing targets. Feature documentation is added, and its status is updated.| |**Landing behavior and position reports**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderWebController.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Resources/reader.js`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/Actions/ReaderBridgeMessage.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/ReaderWebControllerTests.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/Actions/ReaderBridgeMessageTests.swift`, `docs/lots/LOT-087-message-actions.md`, `docs/lots/LOT-111-first-unread.md`|Anchored documents use landing-mode scrolling. The web view holds the target while images and layout settle, then releases it after image settlement or user input. After scrolling pauses, it reports the topmost non-continuation message through the bridge.| |**Position validation and persistence**
`App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderPositionRecorder.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel+Position.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderModel.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/TopicReaderView.swift`, `App/SwiftHFR/Navigation/AppEnvironment.swift`, `App/SwiftHFRTests/Reader/ReaderPositionTests.swift`|The model ignores stale documents, messages outside the loaded page, and continuation blocks. The live recorder advances the current account’s topic position, and app wiring supplies it when available. Tests cover validation and recorder behavior.| **Estimated code review effort:** 3 (Moderate) | ~25 minutes ### Sequence Diagram(s) ```mermaid sequenceDiagram participant TopicReaderModel participant ReaderWebController participant reader.js participant TopicReaderView participant ReaderPositionRecorder TopicReaderModel->>ReaderWebController: provide document anchor ReaderWebController->>reader.js: landOnPost(anchor) reader.js->>reader.js: pin target during image and layout changes reader.js->>ReaderWebController: report post and document token ReaderWebController->>TopicReaderView: forward position event TopicReaderView->>TopicReaderModel: recordPosition(post, token) TopicReaderModel->>ReaderPositionRecorder: record valid position ``` **Possibly related issues** - ezzz/HFRnow#418 — Defines the “Nouveau” banner at the first unread message. This PR implements landing and position stability but leaves the banner out of scope. - ezzz/HFRnow#203 — Requires the scrubber to snap to the first-unread page. This PR defines the first-unread landing target but does not implement scrubber behavior. **Possibly related PRs** - [ezzz/HFRnow#257](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/257) — Introduced reader components whose scrolling, document-building, and service contracts this PR extends. - [ezzz/HFRnow#294](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/294) — Both PRs change `TopicReaderModel` anchor handling; this PR adds fall-forward behavior for missing target messages. - [ezzz/HFRnow#317](https://github.com/ezzz/HFRnow/pull/317) — Defines `ReadingPositionStore.advance` and its forward-only position contract, which this PR uses.
Merge Risk: Minimal · up to 8a472

The change is mergeable; a focused test would protect the visible-message reporting behavior against regression.
Security architecture risk: Low · up to 8a472

Reading history now persists on the device after an account is removed. Existing isolation and account scoping limit the identified concern to local data retention; no broader access change was established. **Retained concerns** - **Low · security · observed:** The newly activated recorder persists account-associated topic and reading-position history, but removing an account deletes only its credentials and session. The history remains in positions.json because store cleanup is not connected to account removal. This is an observed local privacy-retention gap, explicitly deferred by the specification, rather than a demonstrated authentication bypass or cross-account disclosure.
Security review details

**Security Blast Radius** - _observed_ — Persisted state is keyed by account and topic, with a default limit of 500 topics per account. It includes reading position and update time. Removing credentials does not remove these records, so the identified exposure is residual account-associated history in the application's local persistent data. **Trust Boundaries and Controls** - _observed_ — The new reporting path inherits the existing named content world, main-frame-only script injection, disabled page JavaScript and restrictive content policy. Native receipt checks the document token before dispatch. Session-identity changes rebuild navigation, while each recorder retains its original account key, containing normal account switches rather than retargeting old reports to the new account. **Resilience and Maintainability Implications** - _observed_ — The shared actor serializes forward-only updates, rejects duplicate or backward positions, and publishes memory only after an atomic file save succeeds. Failed loads refuse writes rather than overwriting unreadable history. The recorder intentionally suppresses persistence errors, so reporting is best-effort rather than an acknowledged durable-write contract. **Hardening Proposals** - _proposed_ — Define the account-removal retention policy explicitly. If removal should erase reading history, coordinate deletion with revocation or draining of outstanding recorder writes so a delayed report cannot recreate deleted records.

**Explanation** The title names the three main parts of the changeset: first-unread landing (landOnPost in reader.js and ReaderWebController), the legacy separator (TopicHTMLBuilder and reader.css), and reading position recording (ReaderPositionRecorder and TopicReaderModel+Position). It also carries the LOT-111 identifier that the linked docs and issue use. It is concise, and it does not name files or use vague terms.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** The changed files support [`#202`]. `reader.js`, `ReaderWebController`, bridge decoding, `TopicReaderModel`, and position-recording services implement landing and reading-position recording. `TopicHTMLBuilder`, `reader.css`, and their tests implement the legacy separator used by the landing flow. The documentation and feature index record this lot and its scope. Moving `ReaderLinkAction` supports the lint limit without changing its behavior. No unrelated behavior is demonstrated.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#202`] The PR implements landing stability in `reader.js`, position reporting and recording, deleted-target fallback, redirect-preserving anchor behavior, and the legacy separator. The direct issue still requires a visible “Nouveau” marker. No changed file adds that marker, and the PR does not provide evidence that `#202` was amended to move this requirement to `#418`. The issue also requires a fake-page-driver test for late image loading. `ReaderLandingWebTests` uses a two-message fixture with no images and does not test a delayed image or a failed image above the anchor. The reported simulator, CI, and fail-before-change results are not available, so those validation criteria remain unverified. **Resolution** Implement the “Nouveau” marker for `#202`, or amend `#202` to move that requirement to `#418` before merge. Mac check of head `b6de6855` (mac/m2-lead). iPhone 18 Pro simulator, iOS 27.0, real HFR session (read only: nothing posted, flagged or voted). Screenshots show real content, so none are attached.

**Build: FAIL at this head.** `ReaderLinkAction` is declared twice: the new `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderLinkAction.swift` and still in `App/SwiftHFR/Reader/ReaderDocument.swift:26` (brought back by the merge of dev-swift with LOT-087 #463). `xcodebuild` stops with `invalid redeclaration of 'ReaderLinkAction'`. Fix: delete the enum from `ReaderDocument.swift`. The checks below were run with that enum removed in a local, uncommitted worktree only.

- [x] Flagged topic lands with a message at the top of the viewport, no visible jump while images load: **pass** (the spinner, then the message at the top; between 4 s and 15 s the content moved by a few px when a smiley loaded, the same message stayed on top). The flag message and the next one cannot be told apart on screen.
- [ ] Touch/drag during loading releases the pin: **not run** (the swipe was sent at 1 s, while the spinner was still up; no slow-image topic could be forced, so the pin-then-release race was not exercised).
- [ ] Status-bar tap and VoiceOver scroll while pinned: **not run** (XCUITest cannot tap the status bar; VoiceOver not available in this driver).
- [ ] Dashed separator after the flag message, light / dark / Dynamic Type XL, iPhone and iPad: **not run** for the dashed separator (only plain solid separators between messages were seen; a position that moves with every open made the exact flag message impossible to revisit). Light and AccessibilityXL: opened and landed; at AccessibilityXL the message header (pseudo, date) renders one character per line, ugly but probably not specific to this PR. Dark: the XCUI appearance override did not apply and a later retry timed out, so **not run**. iPad: **not run** (the driver could not reach the row in the iPad Favoris list).
- [ ] Failed image above the anchor does not shift the landing: **not run** (no such topic available).
- [x] Reading position recorded: **pass**. After opening, `Positions/positions.json` holds `version 1`, one entry per account with topic (category, topic id), `messageNumber`, `page` and `updatedAt`; no cookie or token in it. Note: the file is keyed by the account name, not by an opaque id.

Counts: 2 pass, 1 fail (build), 6 not run, 0 other.

**Schedule a position report when the image pin releases.** When an image is still pending, `landOnPost` holds the pin. The scroll listener skips the landing scroll and any later scrolls until the pin releases. `releasePin()` does not schedule a report. If the last scroll before release does not change the scroll offset, no scroll event follows. The landed message can then go unrecorded until the reader scrolls. A landing with no pending image already records, so the pending-image case should match it.
Suggested fix

```diff - let timer = null; - window.addEventListener("scroll", () => { - if (pinned !== null) { return; } - clearTimeout(timer); - timer = setTimeout(() => { - const post = topPost(); - if (post !== null && post !== reported) { - reported = post; - channel.postMessage({ type: "position", token, post }); - } - }, 500); - }, { passive: true }); + let timer = null; + const scheduleReport = () => { + clearTimeout(timer); + timer = setTimeout(() => { + const post = topPost(); + if (post !== null && post !== reported) { + reported = post; + channel.postMessage({ type: "position", token, post }); + } + }, 500); + }; + window.addEventListener("scroll", () => { + if (pinned !== null) { return; } + scheduleReport(); + }, { passive: true }); ``` ```diff - if (pinned !== null && settled()) { pinned.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" }); releasePin(); } + if (pinned !== null && settled()) { pinned.scrollIntoView({ block: "start" }); releasePin(); scheduleReport(); } ```

**Skip deleted placeholders for landing and separator selection.** When `MessageBlockParser` encounters a deleted-message wrapper, it emits a block with its original `numreponse` and `isDeleted`; `LiveTopicPageSource.parse` preserves both fields.
